message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023 (i.e., holidays that fell on a Friday or Monday, or were observed on a Monday when they landed on a weekend).  
*(If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I can add the provincial holidays that create extra long weekends.)*

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|--------------|-------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 (observed Mon Jan 2) | Sat Jan 1 – Mon Jan 2 | Observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9 | Always a long weekend. |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | Fri May 20 – Mon May 22 | National holiday, always a long weekend. |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 (observed Mon Jul 3) | Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3 | Observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | Fri Sep 1 – Mon Sep 4 | National holiday, always a long weekend. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | Fri Oct 6 – Mon Oct 9 | National holiday, always a long weekend. |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday Dec 25 | Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 | National holiday, always a long weekend. |

### Quick Summary
- **7 long weekends** in 2023 that Canadians could plan around (including the observed days for holidays that fell on weekends).
- **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) and **Remembrance Day** (Nov 11) did **not** create long weekends in 2023.
- If you need provincial holidays (e.g., Family Day in Ontario, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.), just let me know which province(s) you’re interested in!
